items.notes: businessanalytiq price index (method not published — Medium at best); September 2026 headline figure, US$/kg, delivery basis not stated. SICOM RSS3 settlement not reached (SGX page refused).

notes: Country convention: SG = a regional "South-East Asia" figure applying to all six ASEAN countries (TH, VN, MY, ID, PH, SG); a figure printed for one ASEAN country carries that country. Polymer rows with country JP are businessanalytiq NORTHEAST ASIA indices and apply equally to KR and TW (no country split exists).

Largest source: the SMM price centre (www-old.metal.com/price/...) shows each day's headline average free — every SMM row here was read on 30 Oct 2026 from that page. SMM does not state VAT treatment for most non-China USD rows.

Not found (paywalled or unpublished): Korean domestic carbon and stainless prices; Japanese CRC, S45C bar, stainless and pig iron; CSC and Yusco ABSOLUTE list prices (only monthly changes are public); HMS 1&2 CFR SE Asia / Taiwan; ASEAN 316 / 430; HIPS; SE Asia PP, LLDPE, PVC, PBT; Japanese/Korean billet premiums; NE Asia zinc premium; Japanese cathode premium.
Stale: Taiwan distribution table is 30 Jul 2026 (latest free SteelOrbis week); SE Asia billet premiums are 28 Aug 2026; polymers / RSS3 index are September 2026.
Tokyo Steel is an EAF producer; its list is the public Japanese benchmark but integrated-mill automotive contract prices are higher and not public.
